Deque and hash map management for blockhash insertion, removal, and age checks.

# Purpose
This file implements blockhash storage and age tracking for `fd_blockhashes_t`. It initializes a deque and a hash map, then uses them together to keep a bounded set of block hashes with fast lookup and ordered insertion. The [`fd_blockhashes_init`](<#fd_blockhashes_init>) function sets up the internal data structures, clears the deque storage, and prepares the map with the given `seed`. The code also enforces that each block hash is unique before insertion.

The file provides functions to add new hashes at the head or tail of the deque, remove the oldest or newest hash, and keep the map in sync with deque changes. [`fd_blockhashes_push_new`](<#fd_blockhashes_push_new>) removes the oldest entry when the deque is full, while [`fd_blockhashes_push_old`](<#fd_blockhashes_push_old>) returns `NULL` if the deque is full. The [`fd_blockhashes_check_age`](<#fd_blockhashes_check_age>) function queries the map and computes the age of a block hash relative to the deque tail, then returns whether the hash is within `max_age`.
